title: Pair K gather streams for the embodied transposer
hypothesis: Packet-permuting full K planes and splitting only the mixed-residency tile can satisfy the real paired-stream K transposer without adding a 128 KiB reorder store or changing traffic volume.

revision.supersedes_behavior: stream-major packets within each group-major K plane
revision.failure_evidence: The real K ingress accepted 4096 stream-major flits but raised protocol_error and never completed because stream-1 block data arrived 64 KiB after its stream-0 peer.
preserves: one K and one V head per cluster command wave

remaining_abstractions: V fill/drain overlap and characterized SRAM substitution.
